description: This PHP source file defines the GDPR controller within the Opencart admin panel, managing GDPR requests including listing, approving, denying, and deleting GDPR-related data. It handles rendering views, processing user actions, and interacting with GDPR data models.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing GDPR requests within the admin interface, including listing GDPR entries, and processing approval, denial, and deletion actions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method rendering the GDPR management page with necessary data and sub-views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of GDPR requests.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares GDPR request data for display, including filtering, pagination, and action links.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles the approval of selected GDPR requests, updating their status accordingly.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Handles denying GDPR requests, updating their status to denied.
